**The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)** invites applications for the position of **Research Assistant** for a **12-month research project** .

* **Post:** Research Assistant

The selected candidate will assist the project leader in the research project:

**"The Power of Scarcity: Unveiling How Scarcity Works in Livestream Selling."**

The selected candidate will:

* Assist the Principal Investigator in conducting research activities.
* Support data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
* Contribute to research related to marketing analytics and livestream commerce.

# Funding

## OUR Funding Opportunities

### To Support your Senior Thesis Research

OUR offers three funding cycles for A.B. seniors to support their senior thesis research during the summer, fall and winter. See the thesis funding program page for details, including application deadlines and allowable expenses.

### To Present your Research at an Academic Conference

The Undergraduate Fund for Academic Conferences (UFAC) program offers Princeton undergraduates of any class year or department funding to present their research at a conference related to their field of study. OUR runs two funding cycles annually, in the fall and in the spring semesters, and accepts applications on a rolling basis.

### To Take Part in a Paid Summer Research Internship
First-year and sophomore students interested in doing full-time mentored (and paid) research over the summer can apply to OUR’s summer research internship programs: ReMatch+ and the Office of Undergraduate Research Student-Initiated Internship Program (OURSIP) . No previous research experience necessary.

## Other Funding Opportunities

Search the [Student Activities Funding Engine (SAFE)](http://www.princeton.edu/studentfunding/) portal to access campus-wide funding opportunities for summer internships, senior thesis research, summer study abroad, and other independent projects.

# Funding Opportunities

We welcome inventors to speak with us about different funding options for their startups, and we can make warm introductions to some investors.

## Internal Princeton Funding

The Office of the Dean for Research provides funding to support the University’s thriving research community in ways that complement and supplement traditional funding sources. These internal funding sources include:

Faculty New Ventures Assistance Fund

Faculty and staff members are welcome to apply for funding from the Faculty New Venture Assistance Fund (“Fund”). Applications for Technology Development, Software Development, and Social Enterprise Development, are accepted on a rolling basis.

IP Accelerator Fund
The Intellectual Property Accelerator Fund awards gap funding to Princeton investigators with the goal of fostering and advancing the development of nascent technologies from university labs into commercial development and, ultimately, the global marketplace.

Information on the first ten years of this fund can be found…

[Innovation Fund for Industrial Collaboration](https://research.princeton.edu/funding/dean-research-funding/dean-research-innovation-funds/new-industrial-collaborations)

This fund aims to support research collaborations between industry and academia. Projects can therefore receive up to $250,000 over two years, of which up to $75,000 would come from industry, and $175,000 from the University.

[Eric and Wendy Schmidt Transformative Technology Fund](https://research.princeton.edu/dean/funding/eric-and-wendy-schmidt-tr/)
The Schmidt Fund is used to support the invention or implementation of entirely new technologies that will have a major impact on a field of research or to acquire a piece of equipment or an enabling technology that will change the direction of research in a field. Unlike most endowments, the fund does not need to be spent evenly each year.

…

## External Startup Funding

The OTL has built relationships with a number of angels and early stage investment groups who are looking to invest in Princeton startups at the seed, or even pre-seed stage. We are happy to provide introductions as needed. Some of these groups are listed below. To ask us about introductions, or to explore other potential funders, please reach out.

[BioAdvance](http://www.bioadvance.com/)

Is an active group of investors located in Philadelphia that actively invests early stage venture capital in therapies, medical devices, research tools, diagnostics and health IT in the Mid-Atlantic region.
